title: Store
question: Add a Store to the home screen (free games, Flathub apps, Steam, and Heroic for Epic and GOG)?

ports.name: Free Games
ports.description: Batocera's catalogue of homebrew and freely distributable games, for many systems. Pick one and it downloads straight into your library.

ports.name: Steam
ports.description: Your Steam library and the Steam store. Downloads itself the first time you open it (needs internet, about 3 GB).

ports.name: Heroic
ports.description: Your Epic Games, GOG and Amazon libraries, through the Heroic launcher. Downloads itself the first time you open it (needs internet).

ports.name: Flathub
ports.description: Apps from Flathub (and a few web ones) that EmuBox knows how to set up for the controller: video, cloud gaming, streaming from your own PC, a browser, a media player. Pick one and it joins the Apps section of the home screen.

after: Store is a new entry on the home screen.

Games.description: Places to get games: free games, Steam, Heroic, itch.io and your own Vault pages.

Apps.description: Add apps to the Apps section: web apps, streaming, anything on Flathub.
